map.五子棋禁手判断 使用指南: Gomoku Forbidden Move Judgement User Guide
map.五子棋禁手判断器，判定黑棋三三、四四、长连等禁手并附规则详解，辅助公平对弈与判负: Gomoku forbidden move judge: determines black's double-three, double-four and overline forbidden moves with detailed rule explanations, for fair play and deciding a loss.
map.三三禁手：一子落下同时形成两个活三（两端可延伸成四），判禁手。: Double-three forbidden move: a single stone that simultaneously forms two open threes (both ends able to extend to a four) is a forbidden move.
map.四四禁手：一子同时形成两个冲四/活四，判禁手。: Double-four forbidden move: a single stone that simultaneously forms two rush fours or open fours is a forbidden move.
map.长连禁手：黑棋连成六子及以上（非恰好五连），判禁手负。: Overline forbidden move: black making six or more in a row (not exactly five) is a forbidden move and loses.
map.落子同时产生两个活三演练: Drill: a move that creates two open threes at once
map.：输入某落子使横、斜各形成一个活三，工具判定为三三禁手并标注两处活三位置，提示黑: : Enter a move that forms one open three horizontally and one diagonally, and the tool judges it a double-three forbidden move, marks both open-three positions and notes that black cannot play there (white has no forbidden moves).
map.禁手只限黑棋吗？: Do forbidden moves apply only to black?
map.是。黑棋先手有禁手以平衡优势；白棋无禁手，长连（≥6）对白棋算胜。: Yes. Black moves first and has forbidden moves to balance the advantage; white has none, and an overline (>=6) counts as a win for white.
map.长连对黑棋算胜吗？: Does an overline count as a win for black?
map.不算。黑棋长连（六子及以上）判禁手负；白棋长连判胜。: No. An overline of six or more stones by black is a forbidden move and loses; for white an overline wins.
map.落子后同时形成两个「活三」（两端均可延伸成四）才构成；若其一为眠三则不判。: It only counts if the move creates two 'open threes' at once (both ends able to extend to a four); if one of them is a sleeping three it does not count.
